about: I am a results-driven Software Development Engineer with a proven track record of building highly scalable backend systems, optimizing database performance, and executing complex, zero-downtime migrations. With professional experience at industry-leading organizations like Kotak811 and Amazon, I specialize in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies.

bullets: Delivered 3 critical features that enhanced the service's Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) by 2.5x, directly contributing to business growth.
Owned the end-to-end migration of Kotak811.com to Kotak811.bank.in, ensuring zero disruption across all dependent applications and services.
Architected and deployed event-driven microservices using Node.js, Kafka, and MongoDB, successfully processing 10K+ concurrent requests with 99.9% uptime.
Optimized MongoDB performance through mongoose.lean enforcement, index pruning, and S3 offloading strategies, achieving a 20% reduction in query latency and a 35% decrease in memory consumption.
Engineered a Video KYC system utilizing AWS Amplify to process approximately 12K daily verifications, decreasing verification time by 50% and improving accuracy by 25%.
Eliminated critical production issues by resolving Node.js memory leaks and unhandled promise rejections, reducing API timeouts by 80%.
Built a high-throughput DynamoDB-to-DynamoDB live migration service supporting 1M TPS with 2ms read latency and 30ms write latency to ensure 100% data consistency.
Implemented zero-downtime database migrations with schema transformation and instant rollback capabilities for critical production workloads.
Reduced the operational ticket backlog by 30% through systematic debugging and root cause analysis.
Owned the end-to-end authentication system, company profile management, and an ML-based resume ranking algorithm for candidate evaluation.
Integrated a SonarQube-based automated testing pipeline, decreasing post-release bugs by 50% and improving overall code maintainability.

bullets: Built a full-featured social media platform with authentication, real-time follower systems, and core engagement features (tweets, likes, comments).
Architected a RESTful API with Django ORM for efficient database operations.
